findings.title: Autumn light primary text misses AA contrast
findings.evidence: Source-verified: Autumn light accent #A6601F becomes cs.act; CSPrimaryStyle uses cs.bg0 #F4F1E9 as text. Relative-luminance contrast is 4.312:1. Default name role is 17pt semibold, below the large-bold exemption. Other 21 normal-state look/theme combinations clear 4.5:1; this is a specific combination, not a global palette failure.
findings.impact: The main action becomes harder to read for low-vision golfers selecting Autumn in Light.
findings.standard: WCAG 1.4.3 normal text contrast; iOS accessibility contrast guidance.
findings.recommendation: Resolve action ink/paint in the token system for this pair; verify every look in both appearances, including pressed and busy states.
findings.verification: source + computed contrast; not a device observation

findings.title: Album read failure is presented as an empty album
findings.evidence: Source-verified: the state enum only has opening/empty/ready. Both league-mate and album read failures enter catch and set .empty. The resulting sentence directs the golfer to add photographs; there is no failure state or retry action in this screen.
findings.impact: A temporary read failure incorrectly says existing memories are absent, and sends the golfer toward adding photos instead of recovering the read.
findings.standard: Repository failed-read-is-not-empty rule; actionable error recovery.
findings.recommendation: Add a truthful failed state with retry and preserve already loaded items during a refresh failure.

findings.title: Whole-card geometry is fixed even when its type grows
findings.evidence: Source-verified geometry: the AX branch adds a horizontal scroller, but all text cells and row labels remain height:20. The column roles are uncapped Dynamic Type. With yards at ordinary sizes the contents need 30 + 9×32 + 40 =358pt; CSLeaf adds 24pt horizontal padding (382pt before the parent page gutter). Ordinary-size branch has no horizontal scroller. This cannot fit a 375pt phone even before outer padding. Actual clipping/overlap shape still needs a capture.
findings.impact: A golfer reading the offline course card on a narrow phone or at accessibility size can lose the alignment and legibility of yards, par and hole numbers.
findings.standard: iOS Dynamic Type/adaptive layout; repository AX3 and compact-phone acceptance.
findings.recommendation: Let row height follow measured text; choose a horizontal grid or fit strategy from available width at all type sizes, with pinned row labels.

findings.title: Calendar day targets fall below 44pt on compact iPhones
findings.evidence: Source-verified: outer padding is 20 each side, calendar padding 12 each side, seven flexible columns with six 4pt gaps. At 375pt width: (375-40-24-24)/7 =41pt per day; at 402pt it is44.86pt. A minHeight:44 does not give the narrow columns a 44pt width.
findings.impact: Picking a nearby calendar day is less reliable on compact phones, especially outdoors or with reduced motor precision.
findings.standard: iOS 44×44pt target guidance; compact width is in shipped iPhone scope.
findings.recommendation: Reclaim horizontal spacing or provide a compact date-selection arrangement whose actual hit bounds meet 44pt.
findings.verification: source layout arithmetic; not a touch trace

findings.title: Generic sheets declare modality without owning keyboard focus
findings.evidence: Source-verified: openSheet fills and opens a div with aria-modal=true, freezes body scrolling, and wires rows. It never moves focus into the sheet, makes the background inert, traps Tab, or restores the invoking focus when closeSheet runs. Document key handlers include Escape and shortcuts but no modal focus management. This is distinct from the Book, which correctly uses dialog.showModal() at19609.
findings.impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users can remain on or reach controls behind a visually blocking receipt/form instead of entering the active task.
findings.standard: WCAG 2.4.3 focus order and 4.1.2 semantic/state consistency; modal dialog keyboard pattern.
findings.recommendation: Give the shared sheet host an explicit focus lifecycle and background isolation, preserving its existing sheet geometry and nested-sheet behavior.

findings.title: Legal-page links fail contrast in Light
findings.evidence: Source-verified: links and the13px heading use #9A7B18. Contrast is4.023:1 on white section panels and3.564:1 on #EFF2EE page ground, below4.5:1. Links are ordinary reading size, not large text.
findings.impact: The privacy, terms and account-support links are harder to read on the page where people need to inspect the product’s promises.
findings.recommendation: Use the current action/text tokens and verify link, hover and visited states in both appearances; retain the legal copy.

findings.title: Wizard explanation controls are 18px and use low-contrast dim ink
findings.evidence: Source-verified: .ibtn is18×18px with padding:0; the actual wizard buttons use it for presets, counting rounds and minimums. Its dim glyph on bg2 is2.277:1 dark and2.289:1 light. No later size/color override exists except hover/expanded state. Score step buttons are also36×36px at1841, a44px-guidance gap, though above WCAG2.2’s24px minimum.
findings.impact: The controls that explain competition setup are difficult to hit and visually weak at the moment the golfer needs clarification.
findings.standard: WCAG1.4.11 non-text control contrast3:1; WCAG2.5.8 target size minimum depends on spacing; product44px touch guidance.
findings.recommendation: Keep the small visual glyph if desired but give it an honest44px hit region and readable token ink without colliding with its label.
findings.verification: source; not a measured browser target audit

findings.title: Legal is a separate palette and theme-default system
findings.evidence: Source-verified: legal uses old gray-black/cool-light literals and OS fallback, while get/support read cs_theme before paint and default new visitors to dark using the canonical green-black/almanac palette. Legal applies a saved explicit theme only in a footer script. Its card borders and gold/orange link role are also outside the current token roles.
findings.impact: Opening legal from acquisition/support changes the product’s visual identity, and a first-time visitor gets different appearance defaults by route.
findings.standard: D76 dark-first default; canonical tokens/brand application consistency.
findings.recommendation: Bring legal’s shell onto the current static-page tokens and the same prepaint theme resolver as get/support; preserve all legal wording.

findings.title: Spacing-token adoption is still a large ratcheted debt
findings.evidence: Fresh exact LINT-06 extraction:332 native +844 index.html =1,176 off-scale spacing values. The current baseline is1,193; ROAD_TO_TEN reported1,206. This rule counts disallowed numeric values per source line, not all literal spacing, and excludes generated/test directories according to the repository extractor. Report data is in cup-ten-spacing.json.
findings.impact: Repeated local spacing decisions keep repairs from propagating consistently and make each responsive adjustment expensive; counts alone do not prove1,176 visible defects.
findings.recommendation: Pay down literals by touched shared components and measured surface repairs; do not replace every number mechanically or conflate drawing geometry with spacing.
findings.verification: exact source scan, not Impeccable detector
